humanQualityGates.statement: owner confirms any KEY_OBJECTIVES.md revision and affected claim
owner reviews the generated dashboard and product outcome before acceptance or release

nonGoals: automatic merge, rebase, pull request, tag, release, or acceptance
live hosted dashboard or external telemetry service
migration of existing Schema 3.2 control planes

firstVerticalSlice.outcome: A project can explicitly authorize bounded automatic advancement, progress without stage-by-stage approval, stop at a deterministic human review point, and present a truthful offline dashboard
included: legacy Schema 3.2 manual compatibility and opt-in
bounded milestone commits and optional existing-upstream pushes

successSignals.statement: a new project cannot bootstrap until one automation advancement mode is explicitly confirmed
an authorized automatic run advances through ordinary stages without blocking prompts and stops before a fixed human review point
automatic commit and push actions remain bound to the authorized Git target and never perform force push, merge, rebase, tag, release, or acceptance
the human review point produces an offline dashboard and text summary derived from current control and Git state without granting claims

confirmation.summary: Keep PRIVATE_OPERATION self-governance and DEVELOPMENT_DIAGNOSTIC package posture while adding one-time automation authorization, bounded milestone commits and optional non-force upstream pushes, fixed human review stops, and an offline read-only dashboard; existing Schema 3.2 projects remain manual until an explicit compatible opt-in.
